findings.problem: Prisma identifiers were String/text while the migration created UUID columns.
findings.rootCause: The hand-written migration and Prisma schema did not share native type annotations.
findings.fix: Added @db.Uuid to persisted identifiers, converted audit/compensation columns to UUID, and added a compensation foreign key.

findings.problem: Playwright used development servers and covered only 1440 and 390 widths.
findings.rootCause: The initial smoke configuration did not implement the critic evidence protocol.
findings.fix: Use production Next start commands after build, cover 1440/1024/768/390, and write round/viewport screenshots.

findings.problem: Navigation exposed links to missing anchors and link targets could be below 44px.
findings.rootCause: Skeleton navigation was copied without matching sections or minimum target geometry.
findings.fix: Removed nonexistent destinations, enforced 44px link height, and test every hash target and target height.

findings.problem: Duplicate registration was not audited and integration tests did not use production bootstrap filters/prefix.
findings.rootCause: Application setup was duplicated and the conflict path skipped audit.
findings.fix: Centralized configureApp, audited duplicate registration, and added correlated safe-error regression scenarios.

findings.problem: Rerunning seed with a new demo password left existing hashes unchanged.
findings.rootCause: User upsert had an empty update branch.
findings.fix: Seed now rotates password hashes and has a database integration regression test.
